title: SafeSpeech: A Comprehensive and Interactive Tool for Analysing Sexist and Abusive Language in Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned classifiers and Large Language Models (LLMs) on the EDOS benchmark for fine-grained sexism detection (binary, category, and vector levels), and utilizing custom prompt-based analysis to detect conversational content related to Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG).
Testing message-level classification models on benchmark datasets including OffensEval, AbusEval, and HatEval to identify and categorize offensive, abusive, and hateful language in text.
